scripts.build:patch: npm version patch -m "chore: bump version to %s" && next build && git push && git push --tags
scripts.build:minor: npm version minor -m "chore: bump version to %s" && next build && git push && git push --tags
scripts.build:major: npm version major -m "chore: bump version to %s" && next build && git push && git push --tags
scripts.docker:push:dev: docker push internal.sansenshimizu.com/isf/frontend:$(npm run version --silent)-dev && docker push internal.sansenshimizu.com/isf/frontend:latest-dev
scripts.docker:push:preprod: docker push internal.sansenshimizu.com/isf/frontend:$(npm run version --silent)-preprod && docker push internal.sansenshimizu.com/isf/frontend:latest-preprod
scripts.docker:build: docker build -f Dockerfile.production -t internal.sansenshimizu.com/isf/frontend:$(npm run version --silent) -t internal.sansenshimizu.com/isf/frontend .
scripts.docker:push: docker push internal.sansenshimizu.com/isf/frontend:$(npm run version --silent) && docker push internal.sansenshimizu.com/isf/frontend
scripts.release:dev: npm run docker:build:dev && npm run docker:push:dev
scripts.release:preprod: npm run build && npm run docker:build:preprod && npm run docker:push:preprod
scripts.release:patch: npm run build:patch && npm run docker:build && npm run docker:push
scripts.release:minor: npm run build:minor && npm run docker:build && npm run docker:push
scripts.release:major: npm run build:major && npm run docker:build && npm run docker:push
